# Radio Link Failure - Reference Solution

[![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/CrashingGuru/Sandbox_Training/blob/main/notebooks/radio-link-failure-reference/notebook/Radio_Link_Failure_Reference.ipynb)

Reference solution for the Turkcell/ITU Radio Link Failure dataset: downloads the nested archive from the public repo, loads rl-kpis, and trains an imbalance-aware Random Forest (class weighting, PR-AUC, precision/recall) on the ~0.06%-positive 'rlf' target. Shows why accuracy is the wrong metric. Runs end-to-end in Colab.
